schedule_feature_extraction: schedule feature extraction jobs on SLURM using submitit executor with Hydra config
greedy_create_batches: create batches of videos using a greedy bin packing algorithm based on time estimates
batch_videos: batch videos into groups that fit within a SLURM timeout using estimated forward pass times
create_executor: create a submitit AutoExecutor or LocalExecutor for scheduling SLURM jobs with GPU constraints
print_completion_stats: print completion statistics including load time, transfer time, and forward pass time averages
